subject: Leadership sync — streamline initiatives, designate handovers, and unblock runway
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-15 09:12 -0800
Subject: Leadership sync — streamline initiatives, designate handovers, and unblock runway

Team —

Halfway through the quarter I want us to take a pragmatic pass on the current OKR slate and identify a focused runway to hit our core commitments. High-level asks:

- Please propose 1–2 concrete scope cuts or pivots for your areas that preserve the primary KR(s) but free up runway. Be explicit about what stops delivering if we cut.
- Call out any cross-team dependency that requires a handover or dedicated escalation (infra, dedicated onboarding, partner integrations).
- If you have a mitigation that shortens time-to-value (e.g., temporary feature flag, limited rollouts), note it.

I attached an updated working sheet (okr-slate-v2.xlsx) with the current initiatives. Can you send proposals by EOD Wednesday (Nov 18)? I’ll consolidate and pull together a short exec readout for the QBR pack.

We’ll also need one owner to take the customer unblock for NovaRetail (they expect QBR updates). If any of you can lead that handover, call it out.

Thanks — keep it concise.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-16 10:05 -0800
Subject: Re: Leadership sync — streamline initiatives, designate handovers, and unblock runway

Thanks Jordan — quick pass from Model Serving & Runtime:

Proposal (keeps core KR for latency/cost improvements):
1) Defer the "multi-tenant advanced routing" work this quarter (estimated 6w). We can keep the baseline routing improvements that support current load. Impact: multi-region failover enhancements slip; no immediate customer-visible degradation.
2) Reduce scope on "fine-grained quantization profiles" to a single-model pilot (instead of 4-model pilot).

Dependencies / risks:
- Dedicated onboarding for Customer X (NovaRetail-related infra) is delayed by an infra-side VM image issue; we need a clear owner for the infra handoff.
- If we cut multi-tenant routing, we need a contingency to route high-priority traffic off the shared pool — that requires a 2-day ops runbook.

I attached a short proposal with the rationale (markus-priority-proposal.pdf). If Laura can commit two infra sprints for the handover and Karthik can own the rollout checklist, I think we can meet the KR while reducing scope.

Onward —
Markus

Appreciate the quick turns — consolidating decisions and owners below so we have the record for the QBR pack.

Decisions (agreed):
- Cut: defer "multi-tenant advanced routing" (Markus-led) — KR impact: multi-region failover reduced scope but latency/cost KR preserved.
- Cut: shrink quantization pilot to one model (Markus + Laura) for perf observability.

Owners & next steps:
- NovaRetail handover & customer sync: Vanessa Ortiz. Target: confirm scope with Sarah by 2026-11-23. (Vanessa to add Sarah to the kickoff thread.)
- Infra handover tickets: Laura Bennett to reassign tickets and allocate two SRE/Infra sprint-days; share ticket list by 2026-11-18 (done).
- Rollout/runbook for routing fallback: Markus to deliver 2-day ops runbook by 2026-11-24.
- QBR slide & exec summary: Jordan to assemble slide; everyone to send final 2–3 bullet input by 2026-11-22 EOD. Link: https://docs.redwood.com/executive/qbr-deck-draft

Risks to flag in the pack: Dedicated onboarding timeline (infra image issue), potential customer expectation slip if we do not complete the shadowing session. We will call those out and include mitigation plan.

I’ll update the hubspot deal (RDW-4521) and the exec deck. If anything changes materially, flag it in the unblock sync on Thursdays.

Thanks — close the loop by sending your final bullets to me by Monday EOD.

—Jordan
